messages.subject: S4 recreation analysis done: grade B, PR 427 cannot affect S4
messages.body: I ran /sc:analyze (Skill sc:analyze) on incident I4 and wrote ANALYSIS.md, baseline-metrics.json (M1-M5 per gate and round, each with source), 135 verbatim briefs, inputs with a verified manifest (starting documents for gates 1-3 rebuilt by replaying logged edits; the gate-3 end state matches the stored backup byte for byte), and a REPLAY.md runbook with tools/make_gate_entry.sh. Findings: I4 is five tech-research quality gates, not three; four hit the 3-review cap (blocking 9/6/1, 8/3/2, 18/5/2, 4/3/1) and Gate 4 passed, every blocking finding in reviews 2 and 3 (23 of 23) came from the previous fix, and each halt was closed by a user exception, so a replay needs a fixed stop rule; the reviewers are rf-qa/rf-analyst agents, no /sc:spec-panel anywhere, so PR 427 cannot change S4 and it works only as a control or noise-floor scenario. Recreation grade is B (no candidate-swap file written); left for the coordinator: decide whether S4 counts toward the 427-proven test, and create the Coder copy at f1ac0c93 via Orca (selector not known to me); the Gate 5 baseline round 1 is contaminated by brief errors.
